tools.name: topic_scorer_taxonomies
tools.description: Lists the six taxonomies with their label and category count. Free. Call it first to pick the taxonomy for topic_scorer_find.

tools.name: topic_scorer_find
tools.description: Finds categories whose path contains the query (case-insensitive substring), optionally within one taxonomy. Free. Returns up to `limit` hits with id and path; pass the id as `category` to the scoring tools.

tools.name: topic_scorer_score
tools.description: Scores text against every category in all six taxonomies (one embedding, cosine similarity) and returns the top `per` rows per taxonomy. With `taxonomy` and `category` it also returns the target's rank, score, gap to #1, and a phrase bank split into phrases the text already uses and phrases it does

tools.name: topic_scorer_gate
tools.description: Pass/fail check: does the text rank within the top `min_rank` categories of its target taxonomy? Returns `pass`, the target's rank and gap to #1, the taxonomy's top five, and the unused phrases to work in. Use it as a content-pipeline gate. Free; read-only and safe to retry.

tools.name: topic_scorer_phrases
tools.description: Returns the ranked phrase bank for one category: 1 to 4 word phrases a page squarely about that category would contain, ordered by similarity to the category. Use it to seed a brief. Free; read-only and safe to retry.
